V2_e4m3_rounding.note: hand-rolled exponent/mantissa rounding against snapping onto nvfp4.E4M3_TABLE

V3a_no_clipping.note: real lm_head weights; ceil-rounded block scales must make clipping impossible

V3c_within_half_grid_step.note: every output within half a grid step of its input -- the achievable statement of 'no error beyond the format's own'

operator_non_idempotence.note: NOT a gate. Inherent to amax-derived block scaling, not a defect: a block whose largest code is 4 rather than 6 gets a different scale on re-encode and its grid shifts. Identical under a pinned global scale, which rules out dynamic scaling as the cause.

consequence: the activation-quality number this quantiser produces can be read as the cost of the FORMAT
